purpose: Reference specifications only. No prices, market availability or suitability for a particular account are asserted. These records are separate from synthetic calculation inputs.

items.name: GBP cash reserve
items.identifier: Currency: GBP; select a named institution before research approval
items.market: Account-specific; protection and access terms require verification
items.structure: Cash balance, not a bond or equity
items.fees: Institution and account dependent; no yield is assumed
items.protects: Reduces equity drawdown on the amount held in cash
items.limits: Inflation, institution exposure and missed equity recovery; does not hedge spending in other currencies

items.name: iShares £ Ultrashort Bond UCITS ETF
items.market: Listed in GBP; broker and investor eligibility unverified
items.currency: GBP share class and base currency
items.structure: Physical, sampled UCITS bond fund; investment-grade ultrashort index
items.fees: Published annual TER 0.09%; dealing, spread and tax are additional
items.protects: Reduces long-duration rate exposure relative to longer maturity bonds
items.limits: Credit, liquidity and interest-rate losses remain possible. Capital is not guaranteed and this is not cash

items.name: Defensive equity research basket
items.identifier: Unselected — ticker, ISIN and exchange required before use
items.currency: Instrument and underlying revenue currencies must be recorded separately
items.structure: Fully funded ordinary shares or unleveraged fund after verification
items.fees: Unavailable until specific instruments and dealing terms are supplied
items.protects: May diversify industry and earnings sensitivity
items.limits: Still exposed to equity-market losses, valuation risk and concentration; defensive is a research hypothesis

items.name: Diversified value exposure
items.identifier: Unselected — ticker, ISIN and exchange required before use
items.market: Unverified; fund holdings and restrictions required
items.currency: Trading currency is not a complete measure of economic FX risk
items.structure: Fully funded equity basket or unleveraged fund after verification
items.fees: Unavailable until a particular product is selected
items.protects: May reduce overlap with expensive AI growth companies
items.limits: Cyclical earnings, financial-sector exposure, value traps and market losses remain; inspect holdings

items.name: iShares Physical Gold ETC
items.market: GBP listing; broker and investor eligibility unverified
items.currency: GBP trading line; USD base currency; no GBP hedge asserted
items.structure: Physical metal ETC issued by iShares Physical Metals plc; not a UCITS fund
items.fees: Published annual TER 0.12%; spread, dealing and tax are additional
items.protects: Research diversifier against some equity and monetary shocks
items.limits: Gold may fall with equities, produces no income and has commodity, FX, custody and product-structure risk

items.name: Protective put specification
items.identifier: Unselected contract; underlying, exchange, expiry, strike, multiplier and settlement required
items.market: No execution permission; actual option availability unverified
items.currency: Premium and underlying must use compatible currency or explicit sourced FX
items.structure: Long fully paid put covering an identified underlying quantity
items.fees: Premium, spread, commissions and any exercise costs required
items.protects: Defined terminal downside below the put strike on the covered shares
items.limits: Protection expires; premium can be lost. Before expiry, intrinsic value alone is not a market valuation

items.name: Covered collar specification
items.identifier: Unselected matched-expiry put and call contracts with covered share quantity
items.market: No execution permission; actual option availability unverified
items.currency: Compatible premium, settlement and underlying currency required
items.structure: Long stock, long put, covered short call; research payoff only
items.fees: Put premium minus call premium, plus dealing and exercise costs
items.protects: Defined terminal downside for the covered quantity
items.limits: Caps upside; early assignment, dividends and exercise terms need separate review. No naked short calls

items.name: Daily inverse product specification
items.identifier: Unselected product; issuer, ISIN, exchange, reset objective and KID required
items.market: No execution permission; restrictions and product availability unverified
items.currency: Underlying index, fund and trading currencies required
items.structure: Daily -1x objective illustration only; no leveraged product allocation
items.fees: Product fee, financing, spread and tracking difference required
items.protects: May offset a single-session index decline
items.limits: Daily compounding creates path dependence; multi-month returns are not the negative of the index return. Losses and issuer risks remain
